outcome.en: Asymmetric two-He periodic cell with local GTH and LDA exchange plus VWN5. Compare PySCF analytic forces, including Gaussian-basis derivatives, with energy finite differences for all six coordinates and independent DFTK plane waves. Separate force basis, k-point, SCF and FFT refinement. BOMD coverage is a force interface and short step comparison; long NVE, CPMD and general materials remain unvalidated.
